title: Senior Regional Manager
company_desc:
The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross-site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.
You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.
main_duties:
Regional & Operational Ownership
●	Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including in-house and BPO partners where applicable)
●	Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve
●	Balance cross-site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy
Strategy & Roadmap
●	Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives with measurable impact
●	Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy/regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments
●	Sponsor and govern cross-site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability
Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency
●	Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites
●	Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team
●	Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)
Stakeholder Leadership
●	Serve as the regional "go to" for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives
●	Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions
●	Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision
People & Organization Leadership
●	Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management
●	Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs
●	Build successor-ready pipelines, enable cross-site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders
●	Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values
requirements:
●	Excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and business level of English
●	Extensive demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multi-site or multi-country operations
●	Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners
●	Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence; strong analytical and experimentation mindset
●	Demonstrated ability to dive into detail, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
●	Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including senior leadership exposure
●	A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations
preferred:
●	Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
●	Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

title: Senior Product Manager
company_desc:
As our next Senior Product Manager, Localization (Korea Market), you will define product strategy and drive execution for experiences serving Korean travelers. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, build impactful products, and deliver high-quality solutions for the Korea market.
You will work with dedicated engineering resources that you help prioritize and allocate. This is an Individual Contributor role.
main_duties:
●	Develop a deep understanding of the online travel ecosystem, market dynamics, competitive landscape, and user needs in the Korea market
●	Define, build, launch, and optimize products and features through testing, experimentation, and rapid iteration
●	Drive localization initiatives that improve the experience for Korean travelers across the product journey
●	Partner closely with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams
●	Translate market insights, customer needs, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps
●	Use data and quantitative analysis to identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and measure product performance
●	Collaborate across regions, product areas, and functions to solve complex problems
requirements:
●	Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field (CS, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or related)
●	Proven ability to use analytics and quantitative methods to inform strategy, prioritization, and decision-making
●	Strong data skills, able to independently analyze performance and generate actionable insights
●	Excellent communication skills in Korean and in English
●	Proven experience in Korea market localization, with deep understanding of Korean consumers and market dynamics
●	Experience developing, launching, and optimizing products in a fast-paced environment
●	Experience leading product strategy, go-to-market thinking, and cross-functional product development discussions
●	Strong entrepreneurial mindset and analytical problem-solving skills
●	Hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and execution
preferred:
●	MBA or Master's degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
●	Experience with data tools such as SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

[채용사 소개]

라라스윗 자체 매출만으로 실체 있는 건강한 성장을 지속하고 있습니다.

# 투자 없이 이뤄낸 실체 있는 성장

글로벌 선도 반도체 IP 및 실리콘 솔루션 기업에서 FAE (Applications Principal Engineer / Manager) 를 채용중에 있습니다.
많은 지원 바랍니다.
main_duties:
Provide technical support to customers integrating DesignWare USB Mixed Signal PHY IP as the primary focus, from initial integration through silicon bring-up and debug
Troubleshoot customer issues across synthesis, static timing analysis, design-for-test, and clock domain crossing in USB PHY and SoC integration contexts
Guide customers through USB 2.0, USB 3.x, and Type-C implementation considerations and design tradeoffs, and help define bring-up and debug plans that reduce time-to-silicon
Collaborate closely with the Korea AE team and R&D and product teams to escalate complex issues, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure timely closure during critical milestones
In addition to USB, contribute to customer support coverage for other high-speed interface PHY IP in collaboration with colleagues, leveraging similar integration and debug fundamentals (e.g., MIPI, PCIe, HDMI, etc.; excluding DDR)
Deliver technical presentations and integration best practices to customer engineering teams during design reviews and key program checkpoints
Travel occasionally to customer sites across Korea and the region to support critical milestones

The Impact You Will Have
Enable customer success on high-stakes tapeouts by resolving USB PHY integration issues that would otherwise delay schedules
Reduce time-to-silicon by providing clear, actionable guidance during integration, constraints closure, and silicon bring-up
Build deep technical relationships with leading semiconductor companies in Korea as their trusted advisor
Shape future IP releases by channeling real customer pain points back into the product team
Expand Our footprint in customer accounts through technical depth, responsiveness, and cross-team collaboration
requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with 15 to 20+ years of ASIC design, verification, or SoC integration experience
Strong working knowledge of synthesis, static timing analysis, design-for-test, and clock domain crossing
Ability to work independently and drive ambiguous, customer-driven issues to resolution
Excellent communication skills in Korean and English, able to explain complex concepts clearly
USB 2.0, USB 3.x, Type-C, or USB PHY integration experience is a strong plus
Broader high-speed interface background (e.g., MIPI, PCIe, HDMI) is a plus and helps with collaborative cross-IP support coverage
Willingness to travel occasionally within Korea and the region

밀도, 젊고 역동적인 스타트업 밀도는 2022년 8월에 설립된 매트리스 스타트업으로, `수면밀도`라는 브랜드를 운영하고 있습니다.

허리건강을 위한 매트리스를 연구하고 개발하며, 설립 2년 만에 연 매출 200억 원 이상을 달성한 빠르게 성장하는 기업입니다.

밀도에서 일하는 것은 혁신과 도전의 연속이며, 정체되지 않고 끊임없이 변화할 수 있는 기회입니다.

새로운 시도에 도전하는 것을 즐기며, 성장과 성공을 최우선으로 삼는 인재를 찾습니다.
main_duties:
• 제품 기획 & 상품화 전략 수립
  - 시장 트렌드, 경쟁사 분석, 타깃 고객 VoC 분석을 바탕으로 신제품 기획 및 기존 제품 리뉴얼 전략 수립
  - 제품 컨셉 정의, 핵심 셀링 포인트 도출, 라인업 포트폴리오 맵핑 및 제품별 목표 가격/원가 구조 기획
  - 제품별 상세 스펙(규격, 내부 구조, 소재, 패키징 사양 등) 정의 및 제품 사양서(PRD) 작성

• 디자인 개발 및 디렉팅
  - 브랜드 컨셉에 부합하는 제품 디자인 디렉팅
  - 제품 디자인 컨셉 도출, 2D/3D 렌더링, CMF(Color, Material, Finish) 설계 및 프로토타입 제작 검토

• 양산 검토 및 유관부서/파트너 협업
  - 국내외 제조사 및 원자재 공급사 커뮤니케이션 (샘플링, 기술 검토 등)
  - R&D·마케팅·SCM·품질 등 유관부서와 긴밀히 협업하여 개발 일정 관리 및 상품 런칭 전 과정 주도
  - 출시 후 고객 피드백 및 판매 데이터 모니터링을 통한 지속적인 제품 개선

• 실무 리딩 및 조직 관리
  - 제품 기획/제품 디자인 업무 우선순위 조율, 프로젝트 일정 관리 및 산출물 피드백
requirements:
• 제품디자인/산업디자인 전공자 또는 이에 준하는 디자인 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
• 가구/매트리스/리빙 분야에서 기획 및 디자인 실무 경력이 7년 이상이신 분
preferred:
• 뛰어난 시장 이해도를 바탕으로 월 5억 매출을 만든 히트 상품 1개 이상이신 분
• 매트리스 소재(폼, 스프링 등) 및 제조 공정에 대한 깊은 이해도를 바탕으로 제품 퀄리티를 컨트롤할 수 있는 분

title: 연구소장(CTO)
company_desc:
초박막 웨이퍼 코팅 및 고배열 방열 소재 분야에서 당사의 독보적인 기술 역량을 한 차원 더 끌어올리고, 글로벌 파트너사와의 기술 교류 및 차세대 R&D 프로젝트를 진두지휘할 연구소장을 모십니다.

초박막 반도체 웨이퍼 보호 코팅 및 세정 기술 (CIS, HBM, HYBRID 공정 수율 고도화 기술): 
다이싱(Dicing) 및 백그라인딩(Backgrinding) 공정 중 미세 파티클과 스크래치로부터 소자를 완벽히 보호하는 독보적 코팅 기술 최적화
공정 완료 후 잔사나 데미지 없이 코팅막을 완벽히 제거하는 전용 박리/세정 기술 최적화 및 차세대 칩 패키징 공정 적용 연구
고성능 필름 테이프 (Film & Tape): 반도체 후공정 및 칩 패키징 단계에서 웨이퍼를 보호하고 공정 효율을 극대화하는 고기능성 점착 보호 필름 및 테이프 소재 기술 개발
차세대 TIM 및 고배열 방열 소재: 탄소 클러스터 분산 기술을 활용한 고효율 방열 소재 연구개발 로드맵 수립 및 실행
main_duties:
핵심 기술 R&D 총괄: 위 명시된 당사 핵심 소재의 기술 고도화 및 양산 수율 안정화 지원
글로벌 공동 연구개발(JDA) 리드: 일본 등 해외 기술 파트너사와의 공동개발협약(JDA) 프로젝트 총괄 및 원활한 기술 교류 주도
연구소 조직 및 IP 관리: 연구원 역량 강화, 핵심 기술 인재 육성 및 글로벌 특허 포트폴리오(IP) 고도화
requirements:
- 정밀화학분야 지식/경험/경력 보유 + 연구소 인력관리 및 운영관리 경험자
- 고분자공학, 화학공학, 신소재공학, 재료공학 등 관련 전공 석사 또는 박사 학위 보유자
- 반도체 코팅 소재, 점착 필름/테이프, 고분자 합성, 방열 소재 분야 R&D 경력 12년 이상

- 유기합성을 통한 신제품 개발
- 공정 최적화 및 기술 검증
- Scale-up Test 및 생산 연계
- 기술문서 및 인허가 자료 작성

- 학력 : 석사 이상
- 전공 : 화학, 유기합성 계열
- 경력 : 관련 경력 3년 이상
preferred:

- 제약회사 경력자

- 영어 가능자 (해외 논문 독해가능 수준)
